title: FTPK Season 4: Something in Common

prize.note: the author tops up this prize over time; it started at 150 USDC and has grown since, plus a small native ETH gas preload for the eventual winner

target_format: 12 English BIP39 words, BIP44 Ethereum m/44'/60'/0'/0/0, no passphrase, order is game order

derivation.summary: solve each of 12 mini-games to get one BIP39 word each, then derive the standard BIP44 first Ethereum address and compare it to the escrow
derivation.certified_against: the public BIP39/BIP44 test mnemonic (12x 'abandon' plus 'about'); no author-published worked example exists for this season

difficulty_note: the derivation is certified and the 12 game pages are mapped; the page-naming integers are not the seed; 0 of the 12 words are confirmed via the oracle; the author's later posts point at scores and Roman numerals as the common thread

leads.title: harvest the rest of the author's X posts (every post since 2026-07-16 is a Season 4 clue; the 2026-07-25 to 2026-08-15 window is missing without a login)
read each game as a number, then as a 1-based BIP39 index (the page names already use that convention)
treat the corner tags as reading rules, especially the shared 5:30 on games 2 and 9
game 11 as Roman numerals on the printed names or their dex numbers
